Implemented a complete Next.js 15 + TypeScript + Tailwind offline chess app with modular structure, `react-chessboard` UI, and `chess.js` as the single source of truth.

## What I Created

- `package.json`  
  Defines a Next.js 15 project with required dependencies: `react-chessboard`, `chess.js`, React, Next, TypeScript, Tailwind, PostCSS, ESLint scripts.

- `tsconfig.json`  
  Strict TypeScript config with `@/*` path alias mapped to `src/*`.

- `next-env.d.ts`  
  Next.js TypeScript ambient types file.

- `next.config.ts`  
  Basic Next.js config with `reactStrictMode`.

- `tailwind.config.ts`  
  Tailwind content scanning + small design tokens (`panel`, `accent`, `soft` shadow) for the modern minimal look.

- `postcss.config.js`  
  Enables Tailwind + Autoprefixer in the build pipeline.

- `.eslintrc.json`  
  Next.js recommended lint presets.

- `.gitignore`  
  Standard ignores for Next.js, node modules, logs, env, TS build info.

- `src/app/globals.css`  
  Tailwind imports and base body styles for dark minimal UI.

- `src/app/layout.tsx`  
  Root app layout + metadata.

- `src/hooks/useChessGame.ts`  
  Core game logic hook:
  - owns `Chess` instance (`chess.js`) as single source of truth
  - legal-move enforcement via `nextGame.move(...)` return check
  - status detection (`check`, `checkmate`, `draw`, `stalemate`, ongoing)
  - turn tracking
  - undo/new game/flip board logic
  - move history via verbose history API
  - includes comment on immutable update pattern (important logic)

- `src/lib/gameStatus.ts`  
  Reusable status label mapping.

- `src/components/ChessBoard.tsx`  
  Board component wrapper around `react-chessboard` with DnD move callback and modern styling container.

- `src/components/GameControls.tsx`  
  Modular controls for:
  - New Game
  - Undo Move (disabled when no moves)
  - Flip Board

- `src/components/MoveHistory.tsx`  
  Scrollable move list panel showing move numbers and white/black SAN moves.

- `src/app/page.tsx`  
  Main responsive centered layout:
  - board + controls on left
  - move history panel on right (stacked on smaller screens)
  - current turn + game status display
  - wires everything through `useChessGame`

## Requirement Mapping

- `react-chessboard` used for UI: yes (`ChessBoard.tsx`)
- `chess.js` used for rules/state: yes (`useChessGame.ts`)
- Responsive centered layout: yes (`page.tsx` with adaptive flex)
- Drag/drop legal moves only: yes (invalid moves return `false`)
- Current turn shown: yes
- Status shown (`check`, `checkmate`, `draw`, `stalemate`): yes
- Buttons (New Game, Undo Move, Flip Board): yes
- Move history panel: yes
- Clean modular structure: yes (`components`, `hooks`, `lib`, `app`)

## Install / Run Commands

From project root:

```bash
npm install
npm run dev
```

If dependencies are missing in your environment, install explicitly:

```bash
npm install next react react-dom chess.js react-chessboard
npm install -D typescript @types/node @types/react @types/react-dom tailwindcss postcss autoprefixer eslint eslint-config-next
```

# Downloads Lichess "standard" board sounds (open source, Chess.com-style wooden clicks).
# Run once from project root:  powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/download-sounds.ps1

$outDir = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "..\public\sounds"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $outDir | Out-Null

$base = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lichess-org/lila/master/public/sound/standard"
$files = @{
  Move    = "move.mp3"
  Capture = "capture.mp3"
  Check   = "check.mp3"
  Castle  = "castle.mp3"
  Promote = "promote.mp3"
  Victory = "victory.mp3"
}

foreach ($entry in $files.GetEnumerator()) {
  $url = "$base/$($entry.Key).mp3"
  $dest = Join-Path $outDir $entry.Value
  Write-Host "Downloading $($entry.Value) ..."
  Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $dest -UseBasicParsing
}

Write-Host "Done. Refresh the app — MP3s will play at volume $((Get-Content (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..\src\lib\chessSounds.ts') -Raw) -match 'MASTER_VOLUME = ([\d.]+)' | Out-Null; '0.6')."

# Downloads Lichess "standard" board sounds (open source, Chess.com-style wooden clicks).
# Castle/Promote are not separate files on Lichess — we alias move/capture locally.
# Run from project root:  powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/download-sounds.ps1

$outDir = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "..\public\sounds"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $outDir | Out-Null

  "capture.mp3"     = "Capture.mp3"
  "check.mp3"       = "Check.mp3"
  "victory.mp3"     = "Confirmation.mp3"
}

foreach ($entry in $downloads.GetEnumerator()) {
  $url = "$base/$($entry.Value)"
  $dest = Join-Path $outDir $entry.Key
  Write-Host "Downloading $($entry.Key) ..."
  Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $dest -UseBasicParsing
}

# Optional aliases (same files, avoids 404 if old code expected these names)
Copy-Item (Join-Path $outDir "move.mp3") (Join-Path $outDir "castle.mp3") -Force
Copy-Item (Join-Path $outDir "capture.mp3") (Join-Path $outDir "promote.mp3") -Force
